enriched_activities.desc: Lie down in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Breathe deeply. Continue sleeping. Adjust pillow. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: morning hygiene including washing and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub soap on hands. Put down soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands under tap. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into sink. Turn on tap. Rinse toothbrush. Put down toothbrush. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Close wardrobe. Take off sleepwear. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Tie shoelaces. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Put on bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out plate. Close cabinet. Open bread bag. Take out bread slice. Place on plate. Open milk carton. Pour milk into glass. Close milk carton. Pick up plate. Walk to table. Sit on chair. Eat bread. Drink milk. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to office.

Enter office. Turn on computer. Sit on chair. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Pick up phone. Dial number. Talk on phone. Hang up phone. Open document. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Stand up. Walk to meeting room. Attend meeting. Take notes. Walk back to desk. Sit down. Open calendar. Schedule appointment.
Stand up. Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Stand up. Clear tray. Walk back to office. Sit down.

Open email. Read new emails. Reply to emails. Open document. Type on keyboard. Click mouse. Pick up phone. Make call. Talk on phone. Hang up. Stand up. Walk to printer. Pick up printout. Walk back to desk. Sit down. Highlight text. Write notes. Open folder. File documents. Close computer.

Turn off computer. Stand up. Pick up bag. Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Pick up pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add meat. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Walk to table. Sit on chair. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Open snack bag. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.
